arc_create_or_update.description: Creates or updates a custom Capability Arc.

color.description: Badge color (emerald, sky, purple, amber, rose, indigo).

arc_delete.description: Deletes a capability arc by ID.

arc_id.description: ID of the arc to delete.

arcs_list.description: Returns all of the learner's custom and planned Capability Arcs, with goals and verified evidence.

arcs_snapshot_and_reset.description:
Saves the current ARCS.json to workspace/_meta/archive/ and resets the active arcs to start from scratch.

Never loses verified evidence. Use when the learner wants to "forget" the
previous roadmap/arcs without destroying already-verified evidence — do
not use arc_delete or a manual file rewrite for this.

reason.description: Why the roadmap is being reset, stored with the snapshot.

arxiv_search.description:
Searches real academic papers (arXiv, IEEE, ACM, OSDI, VLDB) by phrase or keywords.

Returns multiple articles with citation counts, authors, abstracts, and
direct links to ground the architecture.

query.description: Search term, e.g. "lsm tree write amplification".

search_field.description: all | ti | au | abs (not used by the current API, kept for parity).

assignment_generate.description:
Generates a structured engineering challenge (Assignment Engine).

Calibrated to expose technical-judgment gaps. Follows the protocol:
Predict -> Measure -> Mutate -> Explain trade-offs.

arc_id.description: ID of the matching capability arc (customizable via ARCS.json).

implementation_instrument.description: Minimal code or test instrument to run.

measure_phase.description: Exact measurement command and metrics to collect.

mutate_phase.description: Parameter variations to stress the system.

predict_phase.description: Prediction questions to answer before running anything.

assignment_read.description: Reads the active project's ASSIGNMENT.md file for review or continuation of the challenge.

project_slug.description: Slug of the project to read the assignment from.

capability_verify.description: [HARVESTER / REVIEWER] Records verified empirical evidence for a capability goal within an Arc.

arc_id.description: ID of the arc holding the capability.

capability_id.description: ID of the capability being verified.

evidence.description: What proves it — benchmark, measurement, or artifact.

delegate_to_assigner.description: A2A protocol: delegates to the Assigner Agent the creation of a structured engineering challenge (Predict -> Measure -> Mutate -> Explain) focused on a capability goal or judgment gap.

capability_or_goal.description: The capability goal or concept to exercise.

context.description: Context or current implementation of the code.

project_slug.description: Slug of the active project (e.g. sysdesign-m04-storage).

episodes_recent.description:
Session step 0: lists the last N episodes (most recent first).

Use together with state_read to resume context without asking "where did we leave off".

episodes_search.description:
Searches past episodes by keyword (topic, extracted content, or connections).

Use to recall "I've seen this before" across domains.

query.description: Keyword to match against topic, extracted content, and connections.

evidence_list.description: Lists and searches the collection of auditable L2 facts and evidence backing the profile's capabilities.

arc_id.description: Only return evidence linked to this Capability Arc.

search.description: Keyword to match against the claim and metric.

surface.description: Only return evidence from this surface (benchmark, code_review, ...).

evidence_record.description:
[REVIEWER / HARVESTER] Records an auditable L2 fact with an explicit pointer to the L1 trace and the L3 Arc.

Use whenever a benchmark, test, or challenge has been proven.

arc_id.description: ID of the linked Capability Arc.

capability_id.description: ID of the specific capability proven.

claim.description: Concrete technical statement or proven empirical conclusion.

source_l1_id.description: ID of the source L1 trace or episode.

source_ref.description: Path to the code/benchmark file or log.

surface.description: benchmark | code_review | architecture_note | challenge | rescue | chat.

gate_check.description:
Runs the 3-Gate Leverage Filter for Work or Personal Study/Project.

Returns the structured verdict (GO, DELEGATE_AUTOMATE_ASYNC, POSTPONE_RECORD),
rationale, and an anti-impostor anchor grounded in concrete evidence when applicable.

context.description: Context of the demand: corporate work or personal study/lab.

impostor_doubt_expressed.description: Competency doubt expressed by the user, if any.

personal_cluster_deepening.description: Study Gate 1: deepens an existing cluster/project (not a from-scratch novelty)?

personal_demand_and_no_abandon_trap.description: Study Gate 4: high/stable demand in your field through the coming years, with no history of similar abandonment?

personal_topology_before_syntax.description: Study Gate 3: is the first step mapping invariants on paper?

personal_tracer_bullet_fit.description: Study Gate 2: fits in an end-to-end tracer bullet within one focused session?

work_career_moat.description: Work Gate 3: produces a public asset (case study/RFC) with demand through the coming years?

work_high_abstraction.description: Work Gate 1: high-leverage your field work (architecture, data schema, reliability, or evaluation)?

work_squad_multiplier.description: Work Gate 2: becomes a playbook, reusable template, or CI/CD guardrail?

invoke_researcher.description: A2A protocol: delegates a technical question or scientific-literature search to the Researcher Agent (arXiv).

question.description: The specific technical question or uncertainty to research.

library_index.description:
Lists and indexes all 1-page Architecture Notes created in Phase 4 of the projects.

Returns the assets cataloged in the Living Architecture Library with their invariants and trade-offs.

library_save_note.description:
Saves a 1-page Architecture Note (Phase 4 of the Inverted Pyramid).

Requires a strict format: Core Invariants | When to Use vs. Not Use | Traps and Failures.

hidden_traps.description: Traps, scale limits, concurrency failures, or hidden costs.

proof_artifact.description: Command or test that proves the physical intuition gained.

meta_overview.description: Returns the full Meta-Learning overview: NOW.md, Arcs, Projects, and Tiny Experiments/observations.

meta_set_now.description: Updates the NOW.md file (active focus) with active project, mission, objective, and next action <2min.

project_slug.description: Slug of the active project in the workspace.

observation_capture.description:
Records a short, durable observation about the learner or the project as soon as it's noticed.

Don't wait for session close or ask permission. Use for concrete facts
(a decision made, an expressed preference, a project direction change, an
observed blockage pattern, a demonstrated capability). Do NOT use for
opinions, unconfirmed hypotheses, or repeats of what's already recorded —
prefer a few high-quality observations over many trivial ones.

text.description: the observation in 1-2 sentences, factual and specific.

os_read.description:
Reads a file at the workspace's OS level.

NOW.md, INBOX.md, templates in _templates/, sessions and reviews.

path.description: relative to the workspace root, e.g. INBOX.md or _templates/learning-review.md.

os_write.description:
Writes a file at the workspace's OS level (outside projects).

NOW.md, INBOX.md, sessions/<date>-<topic>.md, reviews/<file>. Does not
allow writing to _templates/ or _meta/.

path.description: relative to the workspace root, e.g. NOW.md.

paper_dissect.description:
Dissects an academic paper (arXiv, DOI, URL, or title) in the DeepTutor PageIndex format.

Extracts the structured section/page index, mathematical theorems,
empirical benchmark metrics, surgical citations [Author et al., Year,
p. X, §Y], and a suggested auditable L2 evidence entry.

abstract_hint.description: Optional abstract to speed up the analysis.

paper_url_or_id.description: Paper URL, arXiv ID, or DOI.

title_hint.description: Optional title to enrich the search if the URL is incomplete.

phase_set.description:
Updates the phase (1-4) and status in the project's STATE.md.

Phases: 1=macro-topology, 2=tracer-bullet, 3=break-edges, 4=architecture-note.

profile_onboarding_status.description:
Reports whether the Learner Profile still looks generic (no name/domain set yet).

Call this once at the start of a new thread (alongside meta_overview) to decide
whether to ask onboarding questions before diving into the task.

profile_onboarding_update.description:
Saves Learner Profile fields the learner just answered conversationally.

Only pass fields the learner actually answered — omit the rest so they're left
untouched. This drives the 3-Gate Filter and how agents address the learner.
Full effect (agent instructions) only lands after the next server restart —
tell the learner that plainly, don't imply it's instant.

career_horizon.description: Demand horizon for the 3-Gate Filter (e.g. "2027-2030"). Optional.

work_role.description: Career context for the Work 3-Gate Filter (e.g. "Fintech Tech Lead"). Optional.

rescue_diagnose.description:
Diagnoses cognitive/operational blockages using the 2E matrix calibrated to the report.

Returns the real neuropsychological cause and the ONE immediate prescribed action.

details.description: Context or phrase said by the user.

state_read.description:
Mandatory session Step 0: returns the learner's dynamic profile.

(levels, blockage patterns, rewards, microvictories). Combine with working
memory. NEVER ask 'where did we leave off' — this file answers that.

update_working_memory.description:
Updates a section of the Learner Profile (working memory) — call whenever you notice a
durable fact about the learner (stack level, blockage pattern, microvictory, what
worked/didn't work). Replaces the entire section with the new content.

content.description: New full content of the section (replaces the previous one).

section.description: Section of the Learner Profile to update.

web_search.description:
Broad, free search across the technical web (StackOverflow, GitHub, Wikipedia, Hacker News).

Returns articles, algorithm explanations, technical discussions,
documentation, and real code implementations with no API key required.

workspace_archive.description: Archives/completes or restores a project by moving it between workspace/ and workspace/_archive/.

workspace_delete.description: Safely deletes an artifact file or an entire project inside workspace/ or workspace/_archive/.

is_archived.description: target workspace/_archive/ instead of the active workspace.

path.description: relative file to delete inside the project, or inside the workspace if no slug.

project_slug.description: project to delete; without `path`, deletes the whole project.

workspace_init.description:
Creates the folder structure for a new learning project inside workspace/.

Call BEFORE writing any artifact. Returns the created paths.

workspace_list.description: Lists active and archived projects in workspace/ and all their files recursively.

workspace_read.description: Reads an artifact from the active or archived project.

is_archived.description: read from workspace/_archive/ instead of the active project.

path.description: relative to the project folder, e.g. 01-topology/mapa.md.

workspace_write.description:
Writes an artifact inside the active project's folder.

Path is relative to the project; it cannot leave the folder.

path.description: relative to the project folder, e.g. 01-topology/mapa.md.
